data.headline: Outbreak Alert: Suspected Dengue Cases Rising in Hospital OPD
data.situation: Synthetic demo data: 28-day simulated history plus today's live queue. The hospital OPD recorded a total of 116 suspected dengue cases over the 28-day window. Cases this week are 35 compared to 29 in the previous week, with a week-on-week ratio of 1.21 and a doubling time of 25.8 days. Alerts are triggered for Dhok Hassu with 13 cases this week (usual 3.7) and Pirwadhai with 11 cases this week (usual 2). Other top localities include Satellite Town with 3 cases, G-10 with 2 cases, and F-6 with 2 cases. Age distribution shows 10 cases in under 5, 23 in 5–14, 49 in 15–44, 29 in 45–64, and 5 in 65+. Sex breakdown includes 60 females and 56 males.
recommended_actions: Conduct larval source reduction and fogging in the named localities
Launch community awareness campaigns on mosquito prevention
Ensure adequate platelet-monitoring capacity in the hospital laboratory
Promote the use of mosquito repellents and bed nets
